description: Curated authority map for Blade Vale, distilled from PROJECT_GUIDE.md + CLAUDE.md and verified against the real code. Each entry names where a concept's source of truth lives — the map itself is NOT an authority, it only points at one. `consumers`/`tests` are derived by `dev map` into .dev/project-map.json — do not hand-maintain them here. `./dev authority --check` verifies every listed path exists.

authorities.title: Persistent save (localStorage root + defaultSave + C1 job migration)
authorities.persisted: localStorage 'bladevale_save_v1' — single root, no schema version; load = {...defaultSave(), ...migrateC1JobSaveBack(parsed)}
authorities.notes: PROJECT_GUIDE.md §4 is the save-namespace ownership table. Hard constraint: no new save root; permanent progress must not be duplicated into state.data.adventure4. Corrupt JSON silently falls back to defaultSave.

authorities.title: Story chapters / stage progress
authorities.notes: CHAPTERS + stageProgress are the navigation spine (Home → Adventure → Chapter → Stage → Story/Hunt). Do not create new Story progression (CLAUDE.md hard constraint).

authorities.title: BattleEngine / battle resolution
authorities.persisted: no battle state persisted (rewards flow into save via state)
authorities.notes: TextBattleScreen.start(stageId, onEnd, blessingId) is the entry point. No Adventure-specific BattleEngine (PROJECT_GUIDE §3/§6). ENEMY_SCALING in js/data/balance.js is marked do-not-change.

authorities.title: Loot / drop / reward pipeline
authorities.persisted: drops land in inventory/equipped/weaponInstances (equipment save owner)
authorities.notes: _rollDrop() in BattleEngine is the only drop roll; stage dropTable + weaponDropPoolForStage feed it. No second drop/reward authority; no Loot/World-Tier double scaling (PROJECT_GUIDE §6).

authorities.title: Job roster + job save migration
authorities.notes: jobsPhase8 (56 hand-authored tiered jobs) is the ACTIVE roster; jobs.js is the legacy base it builds on. The retired C1 flat roster is folded back onto host jobs at load by migrateC1JobSaveBack.

authorities.title: Companion / Monster Ranch
authorities.notes: Required Story must not hard-require a companion; no permanent companion loss as exploration penalty (PROJECT_GUIDE §3).

authorities.title: Equipment 3.0 / gear instances
authorities.persisted: state.data.weaponInstances / gearInstances / equipped / inventory / weaponEnhance / weaponAffix*
authorities.validation: npm test (equipment / gear overhaul tests); GEAR_OVERHAUL_* docs
authorities.notes: Regional Gear / Utility Set attach metadata to existing instances — never a parallel inventory (PROJECT_GUIDE §3).

authorities.title: Rune 2.1 (locked spec)
authorities.notes: LOCKED (CLAUDE.md): one Rune per story chapter 1–36, first real post-battle drop unlocks Lv1, +1% per mark with caps, no socket architecture, no region-wide two-Rune distribution, no repeated mark drops, no +5% base scaling.

authorities.title: World Tier
authorities.notes: Hard constraint: no new World Tier authority. Adventure reads only tier rank for optional content availability — never re-applies enemy/drop/item-power tier scaling (PROJECT_GUIDE §3).

authorities.title: Nemesis / Bounty hunts
authorities.notes: No Adventure-specific Nemesis level or reward store; existing intel/huntMode is read as Activity→Trace→Clue→location (PROJECT_GUIDE §3).

authorities.title: World Event framework
authorities.notes: Adventure must not re-resolve event rewards/outcomes/cooldowns — Living World only surfaces the current event as context (PROJECT_GUIDE §3).

authorities.title: Realm visibility / Rift Key / Machine World unlock
authorities.notes: Existing unlock authorities are final; Adventure realm discovery only appends observation records to world2.discoveries — never generates/consumes keys or bypasses Heaven/Underworld/Modern/Machine World unlocks.

authorities.title: Adventure World 4.0 — session / routes / scenes / discovery
authorities.persisted: state.data.adventure4 = CURRENT SESSION ONLY (allowlist in PROJECT_GUIDE.md §4)
authorities.notes: Wraps Story, never replaces it. Forbidden: Adventure XP/token/energy/daily, dedicated inventory/BattleEngine/job/companion/Nemesis/realm progression, permanent progress inside adventure4, Required Story depending on RNG/rare events/one build.

authorities.title: Discovery activities — Fishing / Archaeology / Treasure Hunt / Region Codex
authorities.persisted: state.data.world2.discoveries (shared Rumor Notebook shape used by C2/C5/C7)
authorities.notes: Region Codex is pure read-side aggregation over existing spot/site/hunt/codex authorities — no new save data (C8-1). Resolution writes reuse the shared discoveries shape.

authorities.title: Settlement hub / incidents / seasons
authorities.notes: Deterministic game-progress cycles only — never real-world-clock waits, energy, or respawn gates (PROJECT_GUIDE §3). Incidents write into the shared Rumor Notebook, not a parallel store.

authorities.title: Enemy / weapon / region codex + seen flags
authorities.persisted: seen flags under existing save namespaces (no codex root)
authorities.notes: Spoiler convention: boss/hidden-threat names stay '???' until their own chapter is unlocked — reuse the chapterSelect.js convention (C8-2).

authorities.title: Numeric balance layers / scaling curves
authorities.notes: ENEMY_SCALING (exponential per chapter) is marked 'do not change' by its own calibration comment. chapterMult (linear) must not be touched until the owner decides on the known difficulty/pacing gap (CLAUDE.md).

authorities.title: Story canon / player-facing language
authorities.notes: Do not blindly rewrite authored canon text; distinguish decorative UI glyphs from content before editing (CLAUDE.md).

authorities.title: DOM / MutationObserver patch safety
authorities.notes: Every observer-triggered write must be idempotent. Never unconditional textContent/classList/appendChild/remove+recreate/innerHTML inside an observed subtree (CLAUDE.md DOM safety).

authorities.title: UI design system — Dark Chronicle
authorities.validation: live-viewport gate 390×844 / 375×667 / desktop (manual, per work protocol)
authorities.notes: Text-first hack-and-slash; no platform emoji in rendered UI; restrained monochrome SVG/CSS icons only. The px→rem/clamp retrofit is an open scope question — do not start it silently (CLAUDE.md UIX-7).
